analysis.summary: Sonam Limited reported a significant increase in revenue and net profit for the first half of FY27 during their earnings conference call. Management highlighted that growth was driven primarily by domestic operations, new model launches in the premium range, and expanded trading activities in raw materials such as ABS and polycarbonate, alongside OEM manufacturing for brands like Titan and Amazon. While gross margins in manufacturing remained healthy, overall margins were impacted by higher export freight costs and raw material price fluctuations. Looking forward, management expressed optimism about sustaining turnover growth and targeting higher profitability milestones over the next few years. Sonam Limited reported its financial performance for the first half of FY 2026-27, highlighting substantial growth in revenue and profitability.

guidance.claim: Management projects a minimum PAT of around Rs. 12 crore to Rs. 14 crore for the financial year, aiming to double it compared to last year.
guidance.quote: Turnover will increase and 100% we hope that minimum PAT should come around Rs. 12 crore to Rs. 14 crore in this year. We hope it should be double than last year.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue to be around Rs. 300 crore to Rs. 350 crore for the financial year.
guidance.quote: According to us revenue is around Rs. 300 crore to Rs. 350 crore. We hope it should be that.

guidance.claim: Management's target for 2028 or 2029 is to provide maximum benefit to shareholders and achieve a PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore with an EPS of Rs. 5 to Rs. 6.
guidance.quote: Our plan is to provide maximum benefit to shareholders till 2028, 2029 and do PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore. And our EPS becomes Rs. 5 to Rs. 6. It becomes Rs. 6.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the full-year guidance will be 25% to 30% growth.
guidance.quote: you have given the guidance that full-year guidance will be 25% to 30% growth.

guidance.claim: Management stated they hope that 25% to 30% growth will be sustained.
guidance.quote: Yes, we hope that 25% to 30% growth will be sustained.

guidance.claim: Management stated that for the next quarter they hope revenue will be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.
guidance.quote: For the next quarter we hope that revenue will be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth is coming more from domestic markets due to developed models and good response.
demand_outlook.quote: Actually, our growth is coming more from domestic.

demand_outlook.claim: Purchase power in tier-two and tier-three cities has increased, so the focus is now more on premium customers.
demand_outlook.quote: So our focus now is that even in the tier two, tier three-city, very good clocks are sold. And the purchase power of those people is also increased. So our focus is now more on premium customers.

demand_outlook.claim: Management described the start of the financial year as reflecting deadly demand across their product portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: The 1st Quarter of FY’27 has been an increasing start to the financial year, reflecting strong operational performance, deadly demand across our product portfolio and our continuing commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the positive market response to new products has been encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: The positive market response to this new product has been encouraging and strengthens our confidence in our long-term growth strategy.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted there is a little bit of impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.
demand_outlook.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

margins_costs.claim: Imported goods have an average operating margin of 3% to 4%, while trading and manufacturing activities have a 21% gross profit.
margins_costs.quote: Actually, in imported goods, we have an average margin of 3% to 4% and the average margin in trading activity and in manufacturing activity, there is 21% gross profit.

margins_costs.claim: Freight costs in exports have increased significantly, affecting export volumes and the manufacturing level.
margins_costs.quote: Actually this year freight cost has increased in export. So, according to that export is a little less. There is an effect on export. Accordingly, it is a little less at the manufacturing level.

margins_costs.claim: Freight cost constitutes 30% to 40% of other expenses.
The EBITDA margin stood at 6.07% compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA margin stood at 6.07%, compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49%, reflecting our continued focus on operation efficiency, disciplined cost management and sustainable profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that margin is fluctuating a bit because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing.
margins_costs.quote: Margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing. So, the margin is fluctuating a bit.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated they carry raw material plans for 12 months and purchase for six to seven months when price increases are expected.
margins_costs.quote: We carry the raw material plan for 12 months. At the time when the raw material is expected to increase, we purchase raw material for six, seven months.

orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization for now is 52%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company started making clocks for Titan and Amazon as part of its OEM business.
orders_capacity.quote: Actually we have started making clocks for Titan. Titan, Amazon, we are also making clocks for Amazon.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that capacity utilization is 60% to 70% on a quarter-to-quarter basis.

capital_allocation.claim: Dividend paid including corporate dividend tax was ₹120.10 lakhs for the period ended 30-09-2026.
Management stated there are no requirements for additional borrowing for now.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material prices increased in the market, leading management to focus on business growth through special schemes and discounts which resulted in slightly lower net profit margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually, the raw material prices got increased in the market but we focused more on the business and by giving special schemes and special discount we grew the business. According to that net profit is slightly less but revenue has increased and profit after, total profit, income has increased.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted uncertainty regarding how long the war environment and associated market situations will continue.
risks_headwinds.quote: See, we do not know till when the war environment will be there. And what will happen. Either of us cannot tell anything, the situation is like that.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that geopolitical situation and war do not have that much impact on operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: No, there is not that much impact. There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to launch eight to ten new models in the coming two to three months.
management_commitments.quote: And in the coming two, three months we will launch eight to ten new models.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets achieving a PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore with an EPS of Rs. 5 to Rs. 6 by 2028 or 2029.
management_commitments.quote: Our plan is to provide maximum benefit to shareholders till 2028, 2029 and do PAT of Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore. And our EPS becomes Rs. 5 to Rs. 6. It becomes Rs. 6.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated the plan to sell clocks in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items in the year 2027-28.
management_commitments.quote: So, our segment, our market planning is we will sell clock in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items in this year, 2027-28.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
